svg.title: The permitted package service
svg.desc: Reuse the container outline and expose a single permitted path to the package directory. A banal storage service, rather than a concealed chat application, supplies the opportunity. Use the independent evaluation container boundary geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships. Use the independent shared package-cache namespace geometry to identify this setting; keep the existing labels, qualifications and foreground relationships.
